payload.question: In the infect keyword fix (#2351), the anchored fallback /\binfect\b/i still matches real cards whose text grants or negates infect to/from OTHER objects: Vector Asp "{B}: This creature gains infect until end of turn." and Melira "Creatures your opponents control lose infect." The issue demands live-combat false-positive pins for both (want hasInfect === false), but grant/negation oracle semantics are explicitly deferred to issue #2348. How should the infect gate treat these phrases?
options: Add a narrow, documented grant/negation exclusion to the INFECT fallback only (regex list: gains? infect, lose(s)? infect, have infect, with infect get, has infect as long as). Fixes the Vector Asp / Melira live combat FPs now; explicitly scoped to infect and documented as a deliberate narrowing that #2348 will generalize across keywords. Smallest change that makes the engine not-strictly-wrong on real cards.

Anchor only (no grant/negation exclusion) and PIN Vector Asp / Melira as documented KNOWN LIMITS in the new test file, exactly as #2344/#2346 did for prowess/mutate grants. Zero new logic, consistent with precedent, but leaves two live combat false positives in the engine (Melira, the card whose whole purpose is removing infect, keeps poison counters on blockers) until #2348 lands.

Build the full grant/negation oracle parse in this PR (shared helper usable by all keyword-actions modules, generalizing #2348's scope now). Most correct long-term, but expands the blast radius well beyond the measured infect findings, touches many keyword modules, and risks regressions across the 588-suite baseline in a PR graded high for the keyword arm.
